points.text: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term as Brazil’s president, defeating Flávio Bolsonaro with 51.7% of the runoff vote.
A student-led movement defeated Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić’s party in snap parliamentary elections, and Vučić conceded defeat after nearly two years of anti-government protests.
A federal judge ruled that Maurene Comey was unlawfully fired and ordered her retroactive reinstatement.
Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to as many as 60,000 employees, about a quarter of its workforce, as it invests in AI infrastructure and seeks to control costs.
Voice actors Eric Bauza, known for voicing Looney Tunes characters, and Walter Koenig, who played Pavel Chekov in Star Trek, have died at 46 and 90, respectively.
